---
title: "TrackMan Scouting & Development Reports"
---

## Overview

These reports were developed using TrackMan data and R to support pitcher evaluation and development.

The goal is to combine pitch characteristics, movement profiles, contact quality, and advanced metrics into coach-facing player reports.

## Metrics Included

### Pitch Characteristics

- Velocity
- Spin Rate
- IVB
- Horizontal Break
- Extension
- Release Height
- Release Side

### Swing & Miss

- Strike%
- CSW%
- Whiff%
- Chase%
- Swing%

### Contact Quality

- Exit Velocity
- Launch Angle
- xwOBACON
- Run Value

### Advanced Development Metrics

- Height-adjusted VAA
- Release consistency
- Pitch tunneling proxies
- Movement profiles

## Example Player Report

This sample report combines movement profiles, velocity distributions, release consistency, VAA analysis, contact quality, and run value metrics into a player development summary.

Player-identifying information has been removed.


[Download Sample Report](../files/Trackman-Pitcher-Report-Sample.pdf)
